minor.issue: 'Not to athletes' is a reviewer inference; the source lists adolescents, adults over 70, alcohol use disorder and sleep disorders. 'Many had small samples' is also not stated explicitly.
No effect sizes or dose thresholds. It also omits the 21/27 risk-of-bias finding and the null pooled effects on TST, SE and WASO.
'Modifiable recovery factor during rehabilitation' is not addressed by the review.
Travel and evening-competition framing is extrapolated.

note: A accurately reports pooled effects, k values, dose thresholds and the authors' 'not an appropriate sleep aid' conclusion. B is correct but thin and missing the citation authors.
